statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)

statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying rhythm disturbances
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The diagnosis codes submitted are I48.91, I49.5, I49.9
